transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Um... I guess I'm here because work has been a problem lately. I process insurance claims, and... well, I just keep getting up from my desk. Like, a lot. Even when I know I'm supposed to just stay put and finish my reviews. It's becoming an issue.
Has this difficulty sitting still and staying focused been something you've dealt with since you were a kid, or is this a new problem that started more recently?

Uh... I guess it's not really new. Looking back, it was kind of an issue when I was a kid, too. In elementary school, my teachers used to write that I was bright, but... I don't know, I was always losing worksheets or missing instructions. They had to remind me a lot to just finish my classwork. So... yeah. It's been around for a while.
Besides having trouble sitting still, do you often find yourself interrupting others, talking excessively, or acting impulsively without thinking things through?

Uh... no, not really. I'm not much of a talker, honestly. So... I don't think I interrupt people or talk too much. And I don't really do things without thinking. It's mostly just... the getting up from my desk thing.
Do you notice this same kind of restlessness or trouble focusing happening in other parts of your life outside of work, like at home or in social situations?

Um... I guess so. I mean, at home, I don't really sit down to watch TV or anything. I'm usually just... walking around the apartment. But I don't know if that's the same thing. I don't really go out much to notice it in social situations.
Do you often find yourself easily distracted by things around you or forgetting daily tasks, like appointments or where you put things?

Um... yeah, I guess. Like at work... if people near me start talking about a different claim, or... I just suddenly remember some random errand... my attention kind of just slides off whatever I'm reading. I usually end up having to reread the same section a few times to actually get it. So... yeah. That happens.
When you notice yourself needing to get up and move around or losing focus, do you also feel nervous, worried, or on edge at those times?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I feel... nervous or anything like that. Just... I just need to move. That's all.
Would you say these difficulties with focus and restlessness have actually caused real problems for you—like mistakes at work, missed responsibilities, or trouble managing things at home?

Um... yeah. I mean, at work, it's... it's become an issue. My supervisor actually put me on... like, performance coaching. Because I'm falling behind on my claim files. And they've been questioning my accuracy lately. So... yeah, it's a problem. I was hoping to get on the senior adjuster track, but... I don't know now. I'm kind of worried about it.
Over the past several months, have you also been feeling down, low in energy, or less interested in things you used to enjoy?
Um... no. I don't think so. I haven't really felt down or... anything like that. Just... normal, I guess.
